label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y se acercará Moisés solo a Jehová, y ellos no se acercarán, y el pueblo no subirá con él.
spanish: Y se acercará Moisés solo a Jehová, y ellos no se acercarán, y el pueblo no subirá con él.
grammarChanges: Kept singular subirá: el pueblo is grammatically singular in Spanish, so it takes a singular verb even though the Hebrew verb יַעֲלוּ is 3mp; no rewrite needed.
readerNote: Chose the Spanish-grammatical singular subirá to agree with the singular collective noun el pueblo rather than forcing a plural verb to mirror the Hebrew 3mp form.
